mechanism: Both drugs can cause acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances; ramipril reduces glomerular filtration pressure while zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic, compounding renal risk and potentially increasing zoledronic acid exposure.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and during therapy; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment or alternative bisphosphonate if renal function declines; monitor electrolytes including calcium, phosphate, and magnesium.
